scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['logs','tmp','RUNNING.lock'].forEach(p=>fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})); console.log('[OK] Ambiente limpo.');"
scripts.clean:queue: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const D='fila'; if(fs.existsSync(D))fs.readdirSync(D).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).forEach(f=>fs.rmSync(path.join(D,f))); console.log('[OK] Fila limpa.');"
scripts.daemon:kill: env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 delete all
scripts.daemon:reload: env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 reload agente-gpt dashboard-web chrome-proxy
scripts.daemon:restart: env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 restart agente-gpt dashboard-web chrome-proxy
scripts.daemon:start: env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.daemon:start:prod: npm run check:pre-flight && cd dist && env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.daemon:stop: env -u NO_COLOR npx pm2 stop agente-gpt dashboard-web chrome-proxy
scripts.dev: nodemon --exec "node --inspect=0.0.0.0:9229" index.js --ignore fila/ --ignore logs/ --ignore respostas/ --ignore artifacts/
scripts.preinstall: NODE_OPTIONS= node --input-type=module -e "if(process.env.npm_execpath.includes('yarn')) throw new Error('Use npm instead of yarn')"
scripts.rag:full-rebuild: npm run rag:reset -- --yes && npm run rag:index
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:regression
scripts.typecheck:full: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:browser
scripts.validate:all: npm run check:envlocal && npm run lint:quiet && npm run format:check && npm test
